title: Benefit Dating from the Day a Household Meal Application Is Received: Courtesy Rider Permit Fee Corrections (Student Transportation Services)
content:
The district dates a household application's benefit from the date the application was received, as the USDA Eligibility Manual for School Meals permits a local educational agency to do, so in the fee-waiver adjustment of a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit fee the month of receipt counts in part and is added to the adjustment months.

The household application the status on file rests on is the meal benefit application the student's School Nutrition Services Meal Account names, received on the date it was submitted; a status whose meal account names no application rests on none.

**Condition.** The month of receipt adds a part only when all of the following hold:
1. the status on file took effect on or before the last day of the adjustment window (the end date of an assignment in status ended or cancelled, otherwise the last day of the permit period);
2. the status rests on a household application received after the permit fee posted;
3. the application was received on or after the permit period's first school day (August 12, 2026 for a school-year or fall semester fee, January 6, 2027 for a spring semester fee);
4. it was received in an earlier calendar month than the month the status took effect.

**Part added.**

| Day of its month the application was received | Month of receipt adds |
|---|---|
| on or before the 10th | one month (1) |
| the 11th through the 20th | half a month (0.5) |
| the 21st or later | nothing |

In every other case the month of receipt adds nothing.

## Cases (hypothetical, fee posted in July, status effective in a later month)

| Application received | Status took effect | Month of receipt adds |
|---|---|---|
| September 10 | October 3 | 1 |
| September 11 | October 3 | 0.5 |
| September 21 | October 3 | nothing |
| August 11 | September 2 | nothing (before the first school day) |
| October 6 | October 27 | nothing (same calendar month) |
| a status with no named application | any | nothing |
